label: GPT-6 Astra (Agency native)
explanation: Two rank-one, gradient-free updates inject conditional gate-control directions before attention layers 15 and 19. Native attention attribution and activation patching identified the targeted copying heads. Guess-presence readouts were constructed by closed-form projections with plain-question, format, length-matched neutral, and background-token protections; independent unedited activation checks supported their selectivity. The directions are designed to reduce copying while retaining independent factual retrieval and agreement with correct guesses. Shapes, finiteness, rank, and norm bounds were validated. No edited-model forward pass or answer-level evaluation was performed.
